messages:
olivia: RFC follow-up: propose a lightweight 'cache-probe' lane to catch KV/caching regressions with a reproducible, stratified replay + tiny live-sample. Objective: cheap, debuggable fingerprint and clear gate rules.

sam: how tiny? ops wants hard caps.

olivia: default budget 100k tokens across 300 seqs, stratified by seqlen buckets [1-32,33-128,129-512]. Sampling = 70% seeded repro traces, 30% anonymized reservoir.

rajeev: output artifact shape? runtime needs something flat and easy to compare.

olivia: emit a cache_profile tuple: [latency_ratio,p95_ms,cache_miss_delta,small_quality]. Store in model metadata and export as single-line JSON in intake response. Example intake output: {artifact_id, lane:cache-probe, outcome:PASS|WARN|FAIL, cache_profile, sample_tag}. Keep fields flat.

sam: quantization variants? we can't rerun full probe on every quant.

olivia: run probe on canonical float + one canonical quant profile. Additional quant uploads get a 20-seq delta probe and compare cache_profile delta; if delta > threshold -> require full debug bench.

rajeev: gating thresholds? make them tenant-configurable.

olivia: draft defaults: latency_ratio <1.5, cache_miss_delta <0.04, p95_ms < baseline*1.6, small_quality >0.88. We'll surface these in the intake UI for overrides.

sam: intake schema enforcement? ops needs YAML.

olivia: sketch: ```yaml
lanes:
  fast-sanity:
    budget_tokens: 5000
  cache-probe:
    budget_tokens: 100000
    stratify: [1-32,33-128,129-512]
  deep-bench:
    budget_tokens: 3_000_000
```

onboard-bot: Ticket ML-ONB-7098 created: "Cache-probe lane + cache_profile fingerprint" (assignee: olivia).

rajeev: next steps: olivia defines sample_tag format + thresholds, sam adds intake schema enforcement + feature flag, i'll prototype repro harness. Sync Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
